desc: The new Mesa FFT is a great solution for backcountry hunting. The FFT spotter style stock weighs in starting at 5.5 pounds making it ideal on those long hikes up the mountain. The Mesa FFT utilizes an ultralight contour stainless steel barrel with a Cerakote finish, "seamless" removable radial muzzle brake, and is backed by the Christensen Arms Sub-MOA Guarantee.
